layers.label: Cereal field work
layers.note: Listed field hours per million net edible kcal; least-work single cereal. Partial listed field tasks from Columella, to the threshing floor; current atlas single-cereal energy after seed. Assumed 8-hour workday and approximate 0.25 ha/iugerum. Other staples, threshing, processing, animal care, irrigation work and household duties are outside this budget. Gray means no positive modeled wheat/barley output, not zero work or uninhabitable land. No population or total subsistence-work estimate.
